summary.text: Mike Connolly is a Democratic state representative from the 26th Middlesex District who has served since January 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his top priority is housing and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Mike Connolly graduated from Norwood High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Duke University in 2003, and earned a law degree from Boston College Law School in 2009.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Dorchester, moved to public housing in Norwood, spent time in foster care while his mother recovered from health challenges, and attended Duke on a football scholarship.
He described his earlier work as that of an attorney, activist, organizer and legislative aide.

For 2025-2026 he was vice chair of the House Committee on Intergovernmental Affairs and was also assigned to the Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets; Municipalities and Regional Government; and Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development joint committees.

In the survey, he described himself as co-chair of the legislature's Housing for All caucus and said he supports more housing production, tenant protections, reasonable rent controls and increased taxes on the very wealthy and large corporations.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
